Directions grouped by the clips' identical first frame (S 0/1/5/6, SE 3/15/16/18, E 8/11/12/13/19, NE 4/10/14/20, N 2/7/9/17 in sorted-name order); E came with two walks (654ebfd6 / 71e366f6) - 71e366f6 used (clearer steps). Attack / buff rows keep the flat atlas's frame counts, contact / peak and frame TIMES per direction (tools/clips/bastet_plan.json = the wolf atlas she was benched on), so every hit / cast release keeps its time. Frames (0-based video frames) skip the clips' baked effects: attack S 27-37 (pink smear + white ring), N 8-15 (white burst + droplets); buff S 15-57 (yellow-green halo / rune ring), SE 15-41 (gold rings), E 35-79 (gold sunburst + rings), N 8-27 (gold star behind the disc). S buff: rise 0-14, peak = the clean raised pose after the halo (59). Idle loops = best self-match with a 2-3 s period (the automatic 1-2.5 s ones played at 90-140 ms a frame): S 7+60, SE 57+40 (she winks at 27-30 / 51-54 / 99), E 15+57, NE 32+61, N 74+44. Walk loops = best self-match (Godot probe): S 61+26, SE 54+29, E 19+24, NE 42+24, N 23+25. Sockets = the cyan flame over her book (R 0-70, G ~205, B ~240; no turquoise gems in these clips); the normal attack's thrust-to-hold frames = her PALM, read by eye on the placed cells of this build (orbFix) like the flat plan. S buff rise keeps her closed eyes (11-12, casting). The pose states (leap sign summon burst pray drain hurt ko, tools/clips/bastet25_<pose>.json) are written into the same file by sheet_state.py, and a cliphero rebuild drops them (its hurt row comes back) -> re-run every pose spec after it. Rebuild (Windows: -X utf8, or the JS header is written in cp1252): python -X utf8 -I tools/cliphero.py tools/clips/bastet25_plan.json assets_bastet25.js BST (clip paths = the owner's Drive download on the Windows machine).
